scenarios.title: Commission a saved VLAN profile on a shared NIC
scenarios.summary: A VLAN software interface carries one tagged network over a physical NIC. Match its saved parent, VLAN ID and IPv4 address to the supplied plan, while preserving a second VLAN.
scenarios.objective: Prepare the saved Reports profile on reports0 with 10.150.0.20/24 for the next simulated startup. Reach 10.150.0.50 through reports0 in both supplied cases; an address alone is not enough. Preserve the current Audit selection while re-reading saved files. Keep 10.151.0.50 reachable through audit0 at next startup, with no default route on audit0. Keep audit.nmconnection unchanged and retain the supplied filenames and UUIDs; choose Test startup profiles to check the edited drafts.

steps: Edit the supplied virtual profile, inspect each startup case, and verify current preservation plus future two-way paths.
scenarios.explanation: Reports needs both the supplied IPv4 plan and the correct tagged path. A VLAN subinterface uses a physical parent plus a distinct VLAN ID. Test startup profiles compares the retained current selections with a separate future selection; changing a saved file alone does not repair current connectivity.
hints: Compare the selected Reports parent/tag with the supplied trunk native VLAN and the Reports access VLAN.
A native VLAN return is untagged. Find a supplied parent that carries Reports as a tag in both directions, and keep Audit untouched.
scenarios.simplifications: Bounded in-process static/manual IPv4 VLAN keyfiles on two provided software interfaces and physical parents. Two-way broadcast delivery composes the supplied switching fabric with the IPv4 path projection, not real ping/ARP/kernel or NetworkManager activation. Only 802.1Q, explicit flags=1, literal parents and data IDs1–4094. No priority tag0, reserved4095, nested tags/802.1ad, priority maps, parent UUIDs, discovery, DHCP/IPv6 VLANs, bridge/bond, real boot/reload/daemon/packet or host changes. Conventional interface /1–30 only. Other NM lessons retain their original Ethernet subset.

scenarios.title: Diagnose a VLAN return-path failure before startup
scenarios.summary: Carrier and the IP address can be correct while a VLAN return fails. Diagnose the actual parent/tag path and prepare saved profiles without changing current selections.
